transcript:
MARTIN: Why don't you start your shpiel? Let's get as much audio as we can of you first entering.

DAVID: Ok...

MARTIN: Don't worry, I can cut all you are saying together after. No need to do the presenter stuff..

DAVID: No. It's gotta be right. Gotta be genuine, my man!

MARTIN: Fine, have your stupid scruples. Start whenever you want.

[SFX: DAVID CLEARS HIS THROAT.]

DAVID: I am now in the foyer of the former Heathcote asylum... 

[SFX: Some static can be heard on the line.]

DAVID (CONT’D): The fire didn’t reach this far. In all it seems like a normal derelict building of its time... The windows are thick with grime from decades of neglect... 

[SFX: He starts to walk around.]

DAVID (CONT’D): Upon entering I heard some rats. But what could they be eating in a place like this? Moss grows on some of the window sills... So life is continuing, even in this desolate place... [INCREASINGLY DRAMATIC] I have a feeling though that this place doesn't want us here... [BACK TO NORMAL] Then Martin, here you'd cut in the door slam.

MARTIN: Thought it had to be genuine?

DAVID: Well, we do our best to be genuine. But we're not freakin' saints here, man.

[SFX: The wind howls through a broken pane on the other side of the room.]

DAVID (CONT’D): The owner of the property refuses to rebuild here, just letting it sit vacant. When I questioned him about it, he would not tell me why.

[SFX: HE WALKS ACROSS THE ROOM SLOWLY.]

DAVID (CONT’D): I presume it would be expensive to do anything with it, and this whole area is so remote, there are probably few buyers... Especially with the tragedy that happened here.

DAVID [BACK IN CHARACTER]: How we doing so far? Loud and clear?
